b6-ucdp.rule: UCDP organised violence enters Conflict as a continuous, decayed, per-capita term (CII_UCDP_* in _risk-config.ts) instead of the v8-v14 war (70) and minor (50) class floors, which were step functions on event counts (P3, forbidden move "no step functions on event counts"). The read-time window check (P9) reports the cache window in input health.
b6-ucdp.fixtureCaveat: The fixtures hold the truncated 2026-10 cache (about five weeks: December 2025 tail, September 2026, January-August missing). Their UCDP terms are lower bounds. With the full 365-day window the fixed writers fetch (dry run against the live UCDP API, 2026-10-23), the 2026-10-23T0946Z fixture would read: UA 94, YE 85, SY 83, IR 78, MM 69, AF 68, LB 64, IL 59 (Israel plus Palestine population), PK 50 (advisory floor), MX 47, IN 38, BR 23.

2026-10-21T0628Z.v14: 13 countries (ucdp 5: BR IL IN MX PK)

promoted: P12a (±10% noise: p99 6 against a limit of 6; was a v14 gap)
releaseBlockers: P15d (chronic civil war >= 70): 60-71, 26/31 outside the band; passed in v14 only through the UCDP war floor. In the v14 linear blend Conflict carries at most 18 points, so no Conflict term can meet it; Stage C owns it.
stillGaps: P9: the fixtures' cache reaches 302 of 365 days with January-August 2026 near-empty; passes on a fixture captured after the writers deploy

sensitivity.method: Each constant moved alone; tests/cii-invariants.test.mts rerun on the three fixtures; the passing-property set compared with the default (P5b, P11b, P12a, P15a, P15c).

CII_UCDP_HALF_LIFE_DAYS.upperBoundFromWindow: a quarter of the 365-day window keeps the truncated tail at 1/16 (6.3%; 12.1% at 120 days, 24.5% at 180)

CII_UCDP_RATE_KNEE.source: World Bank FCS UCDP thresholds: 10 per million a year at half the cap

CII_UCDP_RATE_SATURATION.source: World Bank FCS high-intensity threshold, 10 per 100,000 a year

CII_UCDP_CONFLICT_CAP.source: the cap of the other Conflict sources

sensitivity.termProperties: Default constants on the live window: one more death in Qatar (smallest population) moves a score by at most 1.6 points; a monthly UCDP release moves a steady 10-per-million country by 0.6.
